question.text:
Paragraph: $P_{14-16}$ : Paragraph for Questions Nos. 14 to 16 A fixed thermally conducting cylinder has a radius $R$ and height $L_0$. The cylinder is open at its bottom and has a small hole at its top. A piston of mass $M$ is held at a distance $L$ from the top surface as shown in the figure. The atmospheric pressure is $p_0$.
Question: While the piston is at a distance $2 L$ from the top, the hole at the top is sealed. The piston is then released, to a position where it can stay in equilibrium. In this condition, the distance of the piston from the top is

options.text: $\left(\frac{2 p_0 \pi R^2}{\pi R^2 p_0+M g}\right)(2 L)$

solution.text:
Let $p$ be the pressure in equilibrium
Then,
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \therefore \quad p=p_0-\frac{M g}{A}=p_0-\frac{M g}{\pi R^2} \\
& \text { Applying } \quad p_1 V_1=p_2 V_2 \\
& p_0(2 A L)=(p)\left(A L^{\prime}\right) \\
& L^{\prime}=\frac{2 p_0 L}{p}=\left(\frac{p_0}{p_0-\frac{M g}{\pi R^2}}\right) \text { (2L) } \\
& =\left(\frac{p_0 \pi R^2}{\pi R^2 p_0-M g}\right)(2 L) \\
&
\end{aligned}
$$
$\therefore$ Option (d) is correct.
